rule: Cross: adjacent full; distance >=2 half, floor after burst. Zero transfer does not trigger gather.
method: 8 training seeds: ordinary-only and cross-enabled searches (width 64), plus a no-fixed-passive baseline. Goals capped by the old target, 80% of ordinary p25, 95% of ordinary minimum, and 90% of baseline. 12 additional ordinary-only reachability checks per high goal. Witnesses prove sampled reachability, not optimality or all seeds.
